kstar_persistence.mean_loss_gap_when_not.spec: mean second-half loss gap (second-half winner's mean loss subtracted from the first-half winner's mean second-half loss) among the n_included - n_persist series where the first-half winner does NOT persist -- how badly, on average, the stale winner loses when it loses

kstar_persistence.n_curated_included.spec: of n_included, how many are curated (vs FRED-MD population) series

kstar_persistence.n_excluded_min_T.spec: series excluded because the first or second half of the chronological split has fewer than MIN_T_PER_HALF=8 years

kstar_persistence.n_fredmd_included.spec: of n_included, how many are FRED-MD population-sweep series

kstar_persistence.n_included.spec: series analyzed after the minimum-T-per-half gate; n_series_attempted - n_excluded_min_T

kstar_persistence.n_kstar1.spec: included series with first-half k*<=1 (k*=1, the task's 'most fragile' classification, plus the rarer degenerate k*=0 exact-tie case, at least as fragile as k*=1)

kstar_persistence.n_kstar_gt1.spec: included series with first-half k*>1 ('larger k*', the comparison group)

kstar_persistence.n_persist.spec: included series where the first-half pooled winner is STILL the pooled winner on the second half (exact model-name match)

kstar_persistence.n_persist_kstar1.spec: included series with first-half k*<=1 whose first-half winner persists into the second half -- the raw numerator of persist_rate_kstar1

kstar_persistence.n_persist_kstar_gt1.spec: included series with first-half k*>1 whose first-half winner persists into the second half -- the raw numerator of persist_rate_kstar_gt1

kstar_persistence.n_series_attempted.spec: series considered before the >=8-years-per-half minimum-T gate: the 12 curated series (breadth_distinct_predictions.csv) plus the 74 series surviving fred_md_sweep.py's own length/finiteness filters

kstar_persistence.persist_rate_kstar1.spec: second-half persistence rate among the k*<=1 ('most fragile') group

kstar_persistence.persist_rate_kstar_gt1.spec: second-half persistence rate among the k*>1 ('larger k*') group

kstar_persistence.spearman_kstar_over_T_.spec: Spearman rank correlation, across included series, between first-half k*/T1 and the binary second-half persistence indicator (1 = same model still wins, 0 = it does not)

Spearman rank correlation, across included series, between first-half k*/T1 (normalized breakdown point, since T1 varies 13-18 across this population and a raw k* count is not comparable across series with different-length first halves) and the second-half rank-percentile of the first-half winner among all candidate models (1.0 = still the best model on the second half; lower = it fell further down the second-half ranking). This is the headline continuous predictive-validity check for k*
